title: Specify task schema and board architecture
description: Produce board/docs/design.md: decision + alternatives + contract for the task file schema (id, title, phase, skill, status, assignee, description, artifacts, created, updated; enums: 6 phases, 4 statuses), the one-file-per-task ownership model, data flow (agents write files → server reads → browser polls every 2s), risks/fallbacks, deliberate omissions (no auth, no writes over HTTP, no DB).
